symptoms: Small water-soaked spots on leaves that turn dark brown or black, angular
Spots often at leaf edges, leaves look scorched
Black raised scabby spots on green fruit
Spread is fast in warm rainy weather

severity_cues.advanced: Leaf scorch plus fruit spots, spread across the block

favorable_conditions: Warm (24 to 30 C), rainy, storms with wind-driven rain, overhead irrigation

treatment.summary: Copper-based sprays with a bacteriostat, and strict sanitation, because bactericides only suppress, they do not cure
steps: Spray Copper hydroxide 77 WP at 2.0 g per litre plus Streptocycline at 0.05 g per litre
Repeat every 7 days while weather stays wet
Do not work among wet plants, disinfect tools
Use certified disease-free seed for the next season

products.name: Copper hydroxide 77 WP
products.label_source: CIB&RC registered label, waiting period 1 day

products.name: Streptocycline (streptomycin sulphate plus tetracycline)
products.label_source: State horticulture advisory, 0.5 g per 10 litres

organic: Copper oxychloride 50 WP at 2.5 g per litre
Seed treatment with hot water (52 C for 25 minutes) before sowing

source.org: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection, tomato diseases
source.title: Tomato: bacterial spot management

safety_notes: Wear gloves, mask and full sleeves while spraying
Streptomycin products: never increase the dose, and observe the 5 day waiting period
